{"claims":[{"claim_text":"G-8 members adopted the Broader Middle East and North Africa Initiative at this year's Sea Island Summit as a result of President Bush's leadership.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the commitment of the world's leading industrial nations to the Broader Middle East and North Africa Initiative to support political, economic, and social reform throughout the region.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans agree with the Bush Administration that there is no greater danger to people than the nexus of terrorists and weapons of mass destruction (WMD).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Leading allies and friends share the judgment that there is no greater danger to people than the nexus of terrorists and weapons of mass destruction (WMD).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Bush and his fellow G-8 leaders declared in 2003 that the spread of weapons of mass destruction and international terrorism constitute the pre-eminent threat to international security.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The risks posed by the relationship between terrorists and weapons of mass destruction cannot be contained or deterred by traditional means.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for a comprehensive strategy through which the United States works with its allies to ensure that international agreements against the proliferation of WMD are observed and enforced.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for a comprehensive strategy through which the United States works with its allies to detect, disrupt, and block the spread of dangerous weapons and technology.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
